boundary_motion_rule: UNBOUND_FOR_POSITIVE_DT; symmetric half-stage is not adopted as a universal rule; one-sided attachment is not adopted without boundary-type authority; topology resolution alone does not define causal physical response
gplates_research_conclusion: GPlates resolves shared topological sections and topological networks; deforming networks use a triangulated deforming region and rigid blocks. These are geometry/deformation reconstruction mechanisms, not ARCANA causal laws.
half_stage_rotation: documented in GPlates for tectonic sections such as spreading ridges; not generalized to stable, convergent, transform, or pre-rift boundaries

junctions.identity: canonical shared grid vertex; poles collapsed to one spherical point each
junctions.positive_time_velocity_rule: UNBOUND; pairwise means are not assumed compatible

master_state_adjudication.boundary_network_role: one canonical shared geometric interface; polygons are derived from the network

orientation.identity: payload- and grid-keyed deterministic BOUNDARY_ID; no duplicate A/B copies
orientation.normal: unit tangent-plane normal from A toward B; positive (vB-vA) dot nAB means opening
orientation.pair_order: plate_a < plate_b, IDs from parent edge record
orientation.tangent: increasing grid-coordinate direction along edge; signed shear diagnostic changes sign if tangent orientation reverses

process_semantics.convergent_pre_event: no shortening/contact accommodation law; no overlap or silent crust removal permitted
process_semantics.divergent_pre_rift: existing cumulative opening is the sole progress quantity; its geometric accommodation zone/width is undefined, so no physical partition-preserving transition is authorized
process_semantics.rift_split_spreading_subduction_collisio: handoff to separately authorized event/process laws; no automatic continuation
process_semantics.transform: signed shear diagnostic only; no slip accumulator or fault mechanics authorized

relative_motion.meaning: diagnostic/process input only; not event typing or accommodation

scope: R6 synthetic t0 representation and positive-duration boundary semantics; no forward evolution
topology_validation: complete spherical coverage within explicit area tolerance
